appearance.compactHint: Draws the content area slightly smaller.
appearance.title: Appearance

confirm.title: Are you sure?
confirm.dataset: This resets the simulated clock, its speed, the latency and forced errors to their defaults. The Demo wallet is not touched.
confirm.wallet: This restores the Demo wallet's starting balances and removes its simulated activity, votes and proposals.
confirm.all: This removes every ChainBeat setting stored in this browser (language, theme, network, Demo wallet, recent searches) and reloads the page.

data.datasetReset: Demo dataset reset to real time.
data.description: How fresh the data is and how to reset the simulation.
data.refreshHint: How often lists and counters re-read the (simulated) network.
data.speedHint: Pause the simulated clock or slow it down.
data.title: Data

settings.description: Appearance, language, network and privacy. Everything is stored only in this browser.

language.description: Choose the interface language. Search by native name, English name or code.
language.fallback: Text that is not translated yet is shown in English.
language.title: Language

network.description: Which network to explore and where the data comes from.
network.liveUnavailable: Live data is not available in this build: every page shows simulated data. If an endpoint is configured you can test the connection, but the app never mixes live and simulated data.
network.title: Network
network.testHint: Sends two read-only GET requests to the endpoint below and shows what it answers. Nothing is stored and the data source does not change.
network.testOk: Connected to {{chain}}: latest block {{height}}, answered in {{ms}} ms.
network.testPartial: Connected to {{chain}}: latest block {{height}}, answered in {{ms}} ms. Some optional details were unavailable.

testError.timeout: The endpoint did not answer in time.
testError.network: The endpoint could not be reached. Check the address and that it allows requests from this site.
testError.http: The endpoint answered with an error.
testError.invalid: The endpoint answered, but not in the format of a Cosmos REST API, so nothing was used.

privacy.clearAll: Clear all ChainBeat data in this browser
privacy.description: What this app stores and what it can see.
privacy.noNetwork: ChainBeat sends no data anywhere: it has no analytics and makes no requests except for its own files. There are two optional exceptions: the “Test connection” button, which only appears when you configure an endpoint and sends two read-only requests to it, and the Google sign-in button, which only appears after you add your own Google client ID and is then loaded from Google.
privacy.noSeed: ChainBeat never asks for, stores or sees a seed phrase, private key or wallet password.
privacy.storage: Preferences, the selected network, the simulated clock, the Demo wallet, recent searches and any demo account you create are saved in this browser's localStorage only.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.wallet: If you connect a browser wallet extension, ChainBeat reads only your public address and account name, and only after you approve it. Nothing is signed or sent.

keys.ui: Theme, motion, density, layout and favourites
keys.wallet: Demo wallet: fictional balances, activity, votes, proposals
keys.notifications: Which notifications you have read or dismissed, and the local events (wallet, simulated transactions)
keys.auth: Demo accounts: usernames, email addresses, salted password hashes and the current sign-in

demo.chipTip: All data is simulated. Open the demo controls.
demo.controlsIntro: ChainBeat runs on deterministic simulated data. Nothing here is read from, or sent to, a real blockchain.
demo.clockNote: Advancing the clock produces new blocks, prices and events on {{chain}}. Data for any given moment is always identical.
demo.simulateErrorsHint: Every request fails so you can inspect error states.
demo.walletReset: Demo wallet reset to its starting balances.
demo.noticeBody: This workflow is simulated. Nothing is signed or broadcast and no real funds are involved.

about.title: About ChainBeat
about.demo: ChainBeat is running in Demo Mode. Every block, price, validator and proposal is generated deterministically in your browser. These are not current mainnet statistics.
about.privacy: No API key, private key or seed phrase is needed. Optional demo accounts, preferences and the demo wallet are stored only in your browser.
about.languages: Interface languages: {{shipped}} of {{total}}. Translations are machine-assisted and have not been reviewed by native speakers; professional review is recommended before public use.
about.pageDescription: What ChainBeat is, how it handles data, and its keyboard shortcuts.
